caption: The drawing features a large, rounded cauldron with a wide opening and thick rim, rendered in shades of brown and rust, suggesting a metallic material. The cauldron stands on three short legs which are evenly spaced, and it has two large, curved handles attached on opposite sides near the rim. One of the handles extends upward and over the cauldron. The cauldron has a slightly bulged lower body and narrows just above the legs. The interior is darkly shaded, transitioning to a lighter rim. At the top left and right corners of the drawing, there are technical sketches showing measurements: the left sketch displays the cauldron in profile with the handle raised, labeled with a width of "12 1/2" inches, and the right sketch provides a top-down view, also marked as "12 1/2" inches in diameter, with a scale noted as "3/8 = 1'." The main cauldron illustration dominates the center of the page, with the technical sketches set inside rectangular borders in the upper corners. The background is an unadorned light beige.
title: Cooking Pot
